#### Finding a nullity from a rank

Suppose that a $5 \times 8$ [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$
has [rank](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-rank) $3$.

Find $\operatorname{nullity}(\matr{A})$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @thm-rank-nullity with $n = 8$.
